stable_traits.filiations: son of Tam al'Thor (biological parentage questioned in fever-dream)
stable_traits.personality: determined, resourceful under pressure, prone to self-doubt and fear but pushes through it

characters.notes: This chapter reveals through Tam's fever-dream that Rand may not be Tam's biological son—found as a baby on a mountain slope during a battle. Rand is deeply shaken by this revelation but tries to dismiss it as fever-talk.

stable_traits.physical_traits: wounded with a gash along the ribs, burning with fever
stable_traits.filiations: father of Rand al'Thor (adoptive, as revealed in fever-dreams), husband to Kari (deceased)
stable_traits.personality: normally strong and indestructible, now delirious with fever

characters.notes: Delirious with fever throughout the chapter. His fever-dreams reveal he found Rand as a baby on a mountain slope during a battle, brought him home to his wife Kari. He speaks of battles, the Dragonwall, Cairhien, Avendesora, and Laman's sin.

stable_traits.physical_traits: described as 'lovely as a girl', had gentle hands
stable_traits.filiations: wife of Tam al'Thor, adoptive mother of Rand al'Thor

characters.notes: Deceased for fifteen years. Tam speaks to her in his delirium. She apparently agreed to take in the baby Rand that Tam found. Only appears in memories and fever-dreams.

stable_traits.physical_traits: wears a hooded cloak that does not move in the wind, rides a horse that makes no sound
stable_traits.personality: radiates hatred for all living things

aliases_observed.notes: Rand refers to this figure as a Fade

characters.notes: Leads a column of twenty Trollocs in perfect formation. Returns alone to search the forest, coming very close to discovering Rand and Tam. Cloak and horse's silence are unnatural. Rand feels the rider's gaze and hatred.
Only mentioned in Rand's thoughts as he imagines the meal she will serve when they reach the inn. Known for her lamb stew, bread, and honeycakes.

stable_traits.personality: jovial, enjoys drinking brandies and singing when celebrating

characters.notes: Only mentioned in Rand's thoughts about Winternight celebrations. Known for drinking too many brandies and singing 'The Wind in the Barley' in a bullfrog voice.

stable_traits.personality: proud of his past dancing ability

characters.notes: Only mentioned in Rand's thoughts about Winternight. Known for trying to prove he can still dance as well as ever during celebrations.

stable_traits.personality: mischievous, plans pranks that often go awry

characters.notes: Only mentioned in Rand's thoughts about Winternight. Known for planning things that don't quite work out as intended, though everyone knows he's responsible.
Only mentioned in Tam's fever-dreams. Cut down Avendoraldera (a sapling from the Tree of Life), causing a war. 'Laman's sin' and 'Laman's pride' brought war and destruction. Blood was the price.

appearances.whereabouts: traveling through the Westwood from the farm toward Emond's Field, dragging Tam on a litter
appearances.notable_actions: tends Tam's wound and fever; fashions a litter and drags Tam through the forest toward the village; hides from a Fade and twenty Trollocs on the Quarry Road; takes Tam's sword and wears it; struggles with exhaustion, hunger, and cold; is deeply shaken by Tam's fever-dream revelation that he may not be Tam's biological son
appearances.demeanor: terrified but determined, exhausted, struggling with physical and emotional burden, wrestling with questions about his identity

appearances.whereabouts: on a litter being dragged through the Westwood toward Emond's Field
appearances.notable_actions: delirious with fever; speaks of battles over the Dragonwall, the destruction of Cairhien, Avendesora and Laman's sin; reveals in delirium that he found Rand as a baby on a mountain slope during battle and brought him home to Kari
appearances.demeanor: feverish, delirious, mostly incoherent, occasionally lucid enough to speak clearly before fading back into murmurs

appearances.whereabouts: patrolling the Quarry Road between the al'Thor farm and Emond's Field
appearances.notable_actions: leads a column of twenty Trollocs westward in perfect formation; returns alone to search the forest along the road, stopping directly opposite where Rand and Tam are hiding; rides a silent horse; eventually gallops westward toward the farm
appearances.demeanor: searching, methodical, radiating hatred and menace, utterly silent and unnatural

relationships.description: adoptive father and son (though Rand has always believed Tam was his biological father); Rand desperately tries to save Tam's life while struggling with the revelation from Tam's fever-dream
husband and wife (she died fifteen years ago); Tam speaks to her in his delirium and recalls how she agreed to raise the baby Rand he found
adoptive mother and son; Kari died when Rand was young, but he remembers her gentle hands
the rider hunts Rand and Tam; Rand hides from the rider's searching gaze and feels the rider's hatred
friends; Rand thinks of Mat when imagining Winternight celebrations in the village
